title: Coupon Checkout Report
heading: Demo Market: coupon checkout before and after

items.title: Coupon expiry at checkout
items.lead: Members apply a coupon in the cart and pay with Place Order. Each coupon has an expiry time, shown under its name in the cart.

asis.alt: Cart with the expired WELCOME10 coupon shown as Applied
asis.caption: Cart (before)

marks.text: Nothing checks the expiry again after the coupon is added. After WELCOME10 expires at 11:59 PM, the cart still shows it as Applied and keeps the $3.70 discount in the total.

asis.alt: Order complete page showing a $3.70 coupon discount
asis.caption: After Place Order (before)

marks.text: Place Order completes the payment with the discount. The order is paid at 12:08 AM, after the coupon expired, so the store accepts an order discounted by a coupon that had already ended.

tobe.alt: Cart showing a coupon expired message and a $37.00 total
tobe.caption: After Place Order (after)

marks.text: Place Order re-checks the expiry first. The expired coupon is removed and a message explains why, so an expired coupon no longer stays applied (①).
The total returns to $37.00 before the order is placed, so orders discounted by an expired coupon no longer go through (②).

items.title: Coupon in order history
items.lead: Orders lists each order's date, order number, items, and amount paid.

marks.text: The order paid with WELCOME10 shows only the amount paid. Members cannot tell from Orders which coupon was used or how much it took off.

tobe.alt: Orders list showing the WELCOME10 coupon and its discount
tobe.caption: Orders (after)

marks.text: Each order shows the coupon used and its discount, so members can check coupon use right in Orders (①).
